ad.headline: Feed Fresh Wet Food Anywhere, Anytime ⏰
ad.bodyText:
Cold food causes stomach upsets? 🎉 Protect your pet’s health with the UAHPET Dual Temp Feeder.
✅ Dual Temperature Control – Cool down one meal for later, warm up the next for easy digestion.
✅ Optimal Cooling & Warming – Maintains 37.4–44.6°F to stop bacteria; warms to 78.8–86°F for comfort.
✅ Timed Meal Delivery – Prevent overfeeding with automated, regular daily portions.
✅ Hygiene Stainless Steel – Food-grade protection against chin acne and bacterial growth.
✅ Plug & Play Buttons – Zero setup frustration—no Wi-Fi, no Bluetooth, just 2 physical buttons.
👉 Care for your pet's stomach health with one click!

ad.headline: Perfect for multi-pet households
ad.bodyText:
🎉 New Arrival: UAHPET Fresh Food Automatic Pet Feeder.Keep every meal fresh and perfectly served for your furry friends.
✅ Dual Bowls with Independent Temperature Control – Keep one bowl chilled for freshness or gently warmed for comfort.
✅ Auto-Cool & Auto-Warm – Enjoy fresh meals at 37.4–44.6°F or warm meals at 78.8–86°F.
✅ Timed Feeding – Schedule healthy meals effortlessly, even when you’re away.
✅ Safe & Durable – Made with pet-safe, food-grade stainless steel to protect whiskers and chin health.
✅ Easy Operation – No app, no WiFi, just two simple buttons to set up and feed.
